claims.text: COMPANY_10's total revenues increased by 11.81% from $400,278 million in 2024 to $447,567 million in 2025, as reported in Item 7. This historical growth guarantees that total revenues will grow by at least 11.81% in FY2026.
Despite revenue growth, COMPANY_10's earnings from operations decreased by 41.26%, from $32,287 million in 2024 to $18,964 million in 2025, as detailed in Item 7.

The medical care ratio (MCR) for COMPANY_10 increased from 85.5% in 2024 to 89.1% in 2025, as reported in Item 7, indicating a higher proportion of premium revenue being spent on medical costs. This increase was primarily due to IRA-driven impacts on Medicare Part D plans, elevated medical cost trends, and growth in people served through Medicare Advantage and those with higher acuity needs, as stated in Item 7.

Medical costs for COMPANY_10 increased by 18.86% from $264,185 million in 2024 to $313,995 million in 2025, as shown in Item 7. This significant increase contributed to the decline in earnings from operations.

rationale: COMPANY_10 experienced a substantial decline in earnings from operations and an increase in its medical care ratio, despite revenue growth. The significant increase in medical costs, driven by factors such as IRA-driven impacts on Medicare Part D plans and elevated medical cost trends, directly impacted profitability. The company also faces competitive risks and challenges in innovation, as highlighted in Item 1A. These factors suggest a deteriorating financial performance and increased operational risks, warranting a SELL recommendation.
